description: Les stations des eaux usées du Territoire de l'Ouest is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data du TCO, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Office de l'eau Réunion. Dans le cadre d'une démarche "Open Data", l'Office de l'eau Réunion met à disposition les données qu'elle produit: Stations de traitement des eaux usées. Coverage: Territoire de la Côte Ouest, La Réunion. The portal files it under Eau et assainissement. Its keywords are Eau et assainissement, TCO, LA POSSESSION, LE PORT, SAINT-PAUL, SAINT-LEU. The portal shows 902 records. The portal shows 2023-06-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tco-re-portal.
